title: Worker reference pointer range copy
summary: Forward-copies pointer slots and increments each non-null referent's metadata-selected 32-bit counter. The caller supplies range endpoints in ECX and EDX, and the destination on the stack with caller cleanup; EAX returns the advanced destination.
test_description: Compare original and recovered behavior for repeated and null referents, untouched destination and object fields, empty range, single-element null destination, forward overlap and counter wraparound; check return pointers and FS head after every oracle call.
known_limits: The internal original ABI is register-based with caller stack cleanup, so the portable implementation exposes a normal C++ interface; the GCC oracle adapter isolates the fastcall cleanup mismatch in a frame-pointer function.
Ranges must terminate by forward pointer increments; invalid addresses, malformed metadata and longer null-output ranges can fault and are not exercised.
The metadata displacement and counter are modeled from the instructions; the surrounding object type and counter meaning remain unresolved.
